title: Provider-neutral hosted-check and external-observation adapter

binding.correlation: request ID, target digest, and correlation digest

rules: The adapter prepares a bounded request but never sends it.
Local qualification is separate from any hosted or remote observation.
A remote success is accepted only with verification unverified and exact request/target correlation.
No record may claim remote verification, provider success, runtime success, or quality acceptance.
Every component has one unique evidence reference whose digest is its canonical SHA-256 digest.

privacy.allowed_values: bounded identifiers, enumerations, booleans, integer revision, and SHA-256 digests

failure_semantics.side_effects: The model and checker perform no network, provider, CI, remote, Git, Coordinator, AWQ, AWG, UI, or durable-state operation.

limitations: A valid envelope proves only that supplied observations are structurally and digest-consistent.
Local qualification is not hosted-check success, and an unverified remote success is not verified execution or quality acceptance.
The checker does not contact a provider, inspect hosted CI, verify a remote host, run a check, or cryptographically verify external evidence.
follow_up: Coordinator remains authoritative for task revision, claims, leases, and durable state.
AWQ remains authoritative for requirements, gates, and acceptance of this evidence.
A future integration may consume this envelope only through approved Coordinator and AWQ contracts.
